prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a stone-and-plaster harbour town on a windy northern coast. terracotta clay tile roof in warm red-orange cream plaster walls with dark timber framing and a stone plinth. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). Flower boxes under some windows. The whole image is 208 x 192 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the user's attached layout guide into ONE complete JRPG building sprite, using the guide as STRICT pixel-accurate geometry reference, not merely inspiration. Preserve its full canvas proportions (208 × 192 art-pixel grid, magnified 7× to approximately 1456 × 1344 display pixels), roof outer silhouette and position, roof/wall horizontal division, and exact size and positions of ALL existing yellow windows and the dark-brown ground-level walk-through door (even if near bottom of the source image). Do not move, shrink, replace, cover, or invent a different doorway. Roof in upper colored block, front wall seen straight-on in lower block, classic 3/4 top-down RPG sprite view. One-storey stone-and-plaster house of windy northern harbour town: warm red-orange terracotta clay roof tiles with hand-shaped stepped pixel highlights, dark muted timber framing on warm cream plaster front wall, worn stone plinth. Existing windows are small-paned amber glowing from within, only luminous feature, with little flower boxes beneath some. Dark wooden ground-level door in original exact marked footprint. Optional minimal chimney rising into empty top margin, restrained trim and weathering, tiny crates against wall only if not obscuring door or windows. Rich earthy hue-shifted palette with 4–6 discrete shades per material: purple-red saturated shade, buttery yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast ambient light; no night darkness, light pools, cast shadows, vignette, or floor. PREMIUM CLEAN HD PIXEL ART, genuine square hand-placed pixels ALL exactly the same grid size, hard crisp edges, tasteful 3–10-pixel clusters, absolutely no antialiasing, blur, strokes smaller than a pixel, noisy texture or checkerboard dither. Background completely TRANSPARENT alpha, replace and remove ALL magenta of supplied guide; no solid backdrop, no ground, no shadow, no persons, no typography. Maintain guide layout precisely.
